svg.aria-label: The V100 memory levels, smallest and fastest first. Registers at 256 KB per SM, L1 and shared memory at 128 KB per SM, and one 6 MB L2 shared by all 80 SMs are on the chip. Off the chip are 16 or 32 GB of HBM2 at about 900 GB/s, a peer GPU over NVLink at up to 300 GB/s total, and host DRAM over PCIe at about 16 GB/s each way. Against the 6 MB L2 line, a 10 thousand point residual batch and all 75 subdomains at about 15 MB go over, while 2048 point chunks and 20 subdomains at a time, about 4 MB, stay under, so the hot working set fits in L2.
svg.text: V100 memory, small and fast on top
the hot working set has to fit in
